test_title: PYST 8: SSC CHSL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. You have to decide which conclusion/s logically and definitely follow/s from the given statements.

**Statements: **Some Chips are Potatoes. All Potatoes are Fries. All Fries are Snacks.

**Conclusions:**

(i) All Potatoes are Snacks.

(II) Some Snacks are Chips.

options.text: Both conclusions (I) and (II) do not follow.

solution:
Statements:

Some Chips are Potatoes.

All Potatoes are Fries.

All Fries are Snacks.

The Venn diagram as per the given statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a588250c2fd98f745917e2d6b4cdb55d3b761874660a00c4c4a38fd932ab2fa8.png] 

Conclusions:

(i) All Potatoes are Snacks. →** Follow** (Because all potatoes are fries and all fries are snacks, which means all potatoes are snacks is definitely true)

(II) Some Snacks are Chips. → **Follow **(Because some chips are potatoes, all potatoes are fries and all fries are snacks, which means some snacks are chips is definitely true)

Hence, the correct answer is** "Both conclusions (I) and (II) follow".**
